cohort: The study included 140 pre-eclampsia patients with a mean age of 31.28 years at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital.
finding: The study revealed significant underutilization and missed opportunities for LDA for pre-eclampsia prevention, with missed opportunities associated with higher odds of fetal complications.
mod_finding: A significant proportion of patients, both those who had vaginal delivery and those who had cesarean section, experienced missed opportunities for low-dose aspirin use.
